item.title: Sibiya to face allegations at Madlanga Commission
item.description: Sibiya to face allegations at Madlanga Commission Estelle.Bronkhorst Tue, 02/17/2026 - 07:25 JOHANNESBURG - Shadrack Sibiya is set to testify at the Madlanga Commission on Wednesday.The Deputy National Police Commissioner faces allegations from over three witnesses.He's been linked to alleged Big 5 cartel boss Vusimuzi ‘Cat’ Matlala, who is accused of attempted murder.

item.title: Proteas Women falter as Pakistan seal consolation win
item.description: Proteas Women falter as Pakistan seal consolation win Nokuthula Khanyile Tue, 02/17/2026 - 07:30 BENONI - The Proteas Women slumped to a defeat in their third and final T20 clash against Pakistan Women in Benoni. The South African women held an unassailable lead going into the clash, thanks to a 2-0 lead. The tourists won the toss and opted to bat first at Willowmoore Park. Fatima Sana put on a captain’s inning with an unbeaten 30-ball 47 runs, while Sidra Amin and Aliya Riaz added 26 runs each.
